scenarios.steps: Sign in; reload; sign out and sign back in
scenarios.expected: Default active Commenter, never automatic editorial/Admin access; identity persists correctly

scenarios.steps: Cancel login; try protected URL; sign out then try a mutation
scenarios.expected: No stuck/inaccurate success state; protected action denied; no data change

scenarios.steps: Request each of Author, Publisher, Administrator
scenarios.expected: Pending request belongs to actor; no privileges change before approval

scenarios.steps: Cancel; submit again; Admin denies; submit again
scenarios.expected: Valid transitions only; truthful status; no duplicate pending request or privilege grant

scenarios.steps: Approve each requested role in isolated fixtures; reload applicant session
scenarios.expected: Approved access and reviewed request agree; reviewer/time recorded; permitted controls and API rights match new role

scenarios.steps: Attempt approval, self-promotion, another user's request update, forged role fields via direct requests
scenarios.expected: Denied without role/request mutation; hidden buttons alone are insufficient

scenarios.steps: Retain old session; attempt edit/publish/comment after revocation
scenarios.expected: Current authoritative permission controls the result; no stale privilege survives

scenarios.steps: A reads/edits/previews/trashes/restores B's private draft using known B ID
scenarios.expected: Denied; B content unchanged; A can still use own draft

scenarios.steps: Create disposable article; edit title from editor then settings; save/reload; reopen in a second authorized context
scenarios.expected: One synchronized title in form and library; title/body/slug survive; cloud is authoritative, not browser-local article storage

scenarios.steps: Clear/whitespace title; invalid/reserved slug; attempt preview/publish
scenarios.expected: Actionable field error, no false ready tick, no publication; body intact

scenarios.steps: Change text; simulate save failure; attempt navigation; restore connection and retry
scenarios.expected: Failure explicit; no false “saved”; uncommitted changes not silently discarded; recovered save persists once

scenarios.steps: Preview exact revision; publish; open returned URL anonymously
scenarios.expected: Durable release ID; exact preview/public content, title and metadata; no repository write/build/per-article deploy

scenarios.steps: Author-owner/Publisher/Admin edits and saves v2; reload both editor and public URL
scenarios.expected: Editor retains v2; public remains v1 until authorized republish

scenarios.steps: Preview and republish at same slug
scenarios.expected: New release ID; same URL serves v2; old release record remains immutable

scenarios.steps: Change slug in draft; save; inspect library link; then preview/republish
scenarios.expected: Before publish, live link still targets old release; afterward new URL serves new snapshot and old URL is unavailable under current contract

scenarios.steps: Cancel Unpublish and verify unchanged; confirm Unpublish; anonymous refresh
scenarios.expected: Cancel has no effect; confirm removes public article; draft/release/audit remain recoverable; clear status

scenarios.steps: Cancel Trash; confirm Trash; follow old editor link; restore
scenarios.expected: Active list excludes trashed item; direct mutation blocked while trashed; restore returns unpublished content, not a live release

scenarios.steps: Attempt Trash through UI and direct API, including missing-index fixture
scenarios.expected: No destructive shortcut; server rejects while any live publication remains

scenarios.steps: Save from both; publish using stale preview; retry after fresh save/preview
scenarios.expected: Conflict explicit; no silent overwrite; stale preview denied; valid retry succeeds

scenarios.steps: Repeat identical publish request with same idempotency key; reuse key with changed payload
scenarios.expected: No duplicate release for legitimate retry; conflicting reuse rejected

scenarios.actors: Two different drafts requesting one slug
scenarios.steps: Publish one, then second
scenarios.expected: Second rejected; first release and second working draft unchanged

scenarios.actors: Signed out, Commenter, Viewer, inactive, Author
scenarios.steps: Directly attempt restricted save/publish/unpublish/archive/restore operations
scenarios.expected: Denied according to permission matrix with no draft/release mutation

scenarios.steps: Exercise paragraph/H2/H3, bold/italic, nested bullets/numbering, links, quote, callout, divider, clear formatting, undo/redo; save/preview/publish
scenarios.expected: Supported structure persists and renders consistently; unsupported content is rejected, not silently lost

scenarios.steps: Valid upload; add/edit/remove caption and credit; save/preview/publish/unpublish; invalid, oversized, corrupt, cancelled and raced uploads
scenarios.expected: Permanent owned asset; optional metadata preserved; no blob/data URL publication; unauthorized/private assets stay private

scenarios.steps: Insert canonical/shortened/Shorts/parameterized URLs; reject malformed/non-video/non-YouTube; save/reload
scenarios.expected: Responsive editor preview and safe normalized provider data; original document preserved on rejection

scenarios.steps: Preview and public play; unavailable/embedding-disabled/external-failure variants
scenarios.expected: Reader-initiated privacy-enhanced player, no autoplay; safe fallback; page remains usable

scenarios.steps: Open without edit; explicitly convert supported HTML; try unsupported structures
scenarios.expected: Original preserved with provenance; conversion preserves accepted content or fails visibly without lossy save

scenarios.steps: Edit, paste, save, reload, preview, publish
scenarios.expected: No deletion/reordering/corruption; separate platform verdicts, no unsupported global-script claim

scenarios.steps: Keyboard tab/toolbar/dialogs, title settings, nested lists, narrow layout
scenarios.expected: Visible labels/focus; operable controls/confirmations; no lost actions/overflow; preview/review/receipt show correct target origin and lifecycle

scenarios.actors: Commenter, Author, Publisher, Admin; published QA article
scenarios.steps: Create comment and reply; reload anonymously
scenarios.expected: Correct thread/order/body; public identity policy respected; no private owner credentials exposed

scenarios.steps: Edit own comment; cancel then confirm delete
scenarios.expected: Own changes work; deletion does not corrupt the thread; preserved/deleted fields follow approved retention policy

scenarios.steps: Forge owner ID and edit/delete another user's comment
scenarios.expected: Denied; original unchanged

scenarios.steps: Delete another disposable user's comment/reply
scenarios.expected: Moderation succeeds with truthful feedback; unrelated comments untouched

scenarios.steps: Attempt create/reply/edit/delete
scenarios.expected: Rejected; public reading still works

scenarios.steps: Like/unlike; duplicate like; pin/unpin; attempt pin as Author/Commenter
scenarios.expected: Actor-specific like semantics and valid pin permissions; no arbitrary counter/owner overwrite

scenarios.steps: Submit empty/oversized/unsafe markup, forged metadata or raw publication HTML
scenarios.expected: Validation/escaping/sanitization prevents script execution and identity forgery; no unintended mutation
